name: winatmo
description: Native Windows desktop application for Netatmo Weather Stations with web login, SQLite historical storage, flexible multi-curve charting, and a live Windows taskbar widget

scripts.build:main: esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=dist/main/main.js --external:electron --external:node:sqlite && esbuild src/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=dist/main/preload.js --external:electron && node scripts/brand-exe.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main

author: Guido Oswald
